SymbolicEssence.ArchetypalFunction: To embody the sun itself; to see all with solar vision; to drive the sun chariot across sky daily.
SymbolicEssence.SymbolicCore: The sun personified, light that reveals all, daily journey across the heavens.

CulturalContext.ReligiousOrRitualUse: Major cult at Rhodes; invoked in oaths as all-seeing witness; honored at dawn.
CulturalContext.HistoricalEvolution: Titan sun god; gradually superseded by Apollo; merged with Roman Sol.

SymbolicRepresentation.ImageryNotes: Depicted driving golden chariot across sky, crowned with rays, radiating light; often with cattle.
SymbolicRepresentation.PoeticInvocation: Helios all-seeing, who drives the sun across heaven's vault, witness to all deeds.
SymbolicRepresentation.DreamForm: A chariot of fire crossing the sky, its driver seeing everything below

MetaIntegration.RitualFunction: Invoked for truth-seeing, illumination, and as witness to oaths and deeds.
AIPromptSeeds: The sun god who sees all from his daily journey across the heavens.
Light personified, driving the chariot that brings day to the world.
